prompts.prompt: Profile this service, establish a repeatable baseline, and identify the real performance hotspot before anyone edits code.
The command is slow but the cause is unknown. Measure the workload and hand the next agent a hotspot card with evidence.
Use the supplied hotspot card to apply one isomorphic optimization rewrite, verify outputs, and benchmark the delta.
The hotspot card proves allocation churn in the hot loop. Select one optimization lever, preserve behavior, and keep it only if p50 improves.
Run three measured optimization passes, recording each KEEP, REVERT, or STOP decision in a pass ledger.
Repeatedly apply the appropriate performance skill until the requested pass count is complete or the ledger contains a justified stop.
Fix the failing parser unit test and explain the correctness bug. Performance is not part of this task.
Explain Big-O notation to a new engineer and recommend a few practice exercises.
